title: A traveller's access in the browser
caption: Cookies set only by the OTA API (`common/http/cookie-writer.ts`); the page learns the state from `auth.getSession` (`401` = signed out). Only `__Host-vx_csrf` is readable by JavaScript.

states.label: Guest
states.detail: `__Host-vx_bt`: up to 5 `bkg_<id>.<token>` entries, 30 days, newest first.

states.label: Signed-in customer
states.detail: `__Host-vx_at` (900 s) + `__Host-vx_rt` (family: 12 h, or 30 days with remember me).

states.label: Access cookie gone
states.detail: Only `__Host-vx_rt`: the API answers `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, the SDK refreshes once.

states.label: Signed out by the server
states.detail: Refresh reused (`REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED`), family expired, account deleted: cookies cleared.
